title: The Signal
question: Where in the accounts does failure show, and how early?
goals: Learn the new columns, then load and look.
Turn accounting items into ratios, family by family.
Compare the two outcomes without bins.
Follow failed companies back from their last filing.
Read the failure rate along each ratio.
See why deep losses are not the riskiest.
Score each ratio alone, as a model.
Find the ratios that repeat each other.
Map the risk on leverage and profitability.
Add what changed, paired by calendar year.
Measure how far the ratios drift between eras.

shift.name: Finding last year by position
shift.naive_label: Rows a shift pairs with the wrong year
shift.honest_label: Rows a calendar join pairs with the wrong year
shift.why: A company that skips a year has no row for it, so the row before is two or more years back.
